input.quote: Provisions that should reasonably be considered to survive termination of the Agreement will survive and be enforceable after such termination or expiration, including without limitation provisions relating to confidentiality, proprietary rights, indemnification, limitations of liability, effects of termination, and governing Law.
input.rationale: Full-document review (including the confidentiality section, the restrictive-covenant-adjacent provisions, and all of the General Provisions) found no non-solicitation, no-hire, non-poaching or "induce to leave" covenant of any kind, and no such obligation is listed among the surviving provisions. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "no-hire", "recruit", "entice" and "induce" returned nothing; the only references to employees are in the limitation of liability, indemnity and confidentiality clauses, which impose no hiring or solicitation restriction. AP therefore bears no non-solicitation restriction, which satisfies the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"). No redline is warranted; this term benefits us, and we would only need the mutual 12-month fallback (services personnel only, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire) if Kubient later proposes one.
